returnCommit: This RETURN is committed as its own final checkpoint; see branch Git log.
scope: Only shared VA sealing host and its four granted family outputs, plus FIX87 evidence/rows. No official dictionary, source binary/pin, legal record, approval, product-wiring, shared finalizer, route or grant edits.

defaultGeneratorEvidence.companionOutputs: Existing family-local reports/build status/instructions/source receipts regenerated by default host. Host has no external rows.json writer and explicitly excludes historical C11_RETURN_REVIEW.json.
defaultGeneratorEvidence.firstNoRaster: Four preliminary real source/PDF builds used --no-raster; final default output replaces their raster-pending metadata.

environment.cpu: Single CPU affinity; Poppler review extraction nice10.
environment.sourceCorpusScope: Exactly two pinned Virginia originals recovered; not full 499-file/329-PDF corpus.

exploratoryFailures: First raw-V probe treated indirect references as values; dereferenced actual objects and recorded 125 /0 unchecked checkbox states plus all 221 field values. No source record changed.

First composed bbox check asserted nominal 540 pt column; Poppler reports up to 541.282 pt on text fully inside 612 pt paper. Final check measures paper bounds and retained actual geometry; visual review confirms no clipped or overlapping text.

nonPassesAndLimits: Current first full attempt failed on misdemeanor boundary page 10 because the plain Chromium viewer capture had no paper-white region. That failed run remains in build-1-results.json. Only misdemeanor/felony were rerun with unchanged sources, code and calibration.

Previous default build failed in shared markCentroids spread min/max with maximum call stack exceeded. Prior evidence preserved; current default build uses --stack-size=8192 with the same calibrated renderer and unchanged residual checks.

All four existing source-carried-value verifiers exit2 BROKEN_DENOMINATOR: no field-census.census-v1.json with this exact familyId. Reported unchanged; direct source audit is separate evidence, not a relabeled verifier pass.

Final clean-checkpoint preflight exits 1 only for the incomplete global corpus: 2/499 files and 24 missing sampled entries. Worktree cleanliness and all four exact family-source binding checks pass. No global readiness pass is claimed; bounded family builds proceed from exact sources.

Official form-assignment discrepancy remains: current held packet manifest names CC1201 for two routes whose existing host uses matching-statute CC1203. No legal/form-selection decision or approval altered.
Old central raster/product-wiring receipts are unchanged and bind superseded packet hashes. These replacements require fresh central raster and independent reread.
testDoubles: Only four negative record-binding cases replace fs.readFileSync for registry/packet-manifest JSON inside test process memory; positive control and all builders read committed records and real exact sources. No repository legal-record bytes changed.
visualMethod: Poppler 300 dpi renders 56 current composed pages; SHA deduplication yields 41 unique images, inspected through 21 contact sheets. Current default builder separately uses calibrated Chromium for 96 pages. Neither is hosted central raster acceptance.
remainingExternalActions: Captain integrates scoped commits, dispatches fresh central raster for 8 new packet hashes and independently rereads all 4 families.
Retain existing legal/approval/release gates; no route opened.
